turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Dadi? It is me, Aryan. Can you hear me properly?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Aryan? Beta, is that you? Your voice sounds very strange, why are you calling from this number?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I broke my phone during a fight, Dadi. Please listen, I am in a very big trouble right now in Nagpur.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Nagpur? What are you doing there? What has happened, beta?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I had a small accident with a local man's car and the police have detained me. I am so scared and I do not want to tell Papa because he will kill me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh my goodness, this is terrible. Let me call your father right now, he will handle it.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, Dadi, please do not tell anyone! If the police call home, it will be a huge scandal and my career will be ruined.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But how can I help you from here? What do they want?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The lawyer says if I pay twenty five thousand rupees immediately for the settlement, I can go home today. Can you send it to me via UPI?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? I do not have that much in my hand, I have to check the bank.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, Mrs. Khan, the police are shouting at me. Just send it quickly to the number I will SMS you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wait, why did you call me Mrs. Khan? You always call me Dadi.
